  semanage fcontext -a -t print_spool_t '/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed(/.*)?'

cat > /usr/lib/cups/backend/archive <<'ANTRIEB_ARCHIVE_BACKEND'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

OUT_DIR=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'direct archive "Electronic Archive" "Electronic Archive Raw Payload Sink"'
    exit 0
fi

if [ "$#" -lt 5 ] || [ "$#" -gt 6 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "ERROR: archive backend received invalid arguments" >&2
    exit 1
fi

job_id=$1
title=$3
case "$job_id" in
    *[!0-9]*|'')
        printf '%s\n' "ERROR: invalid CUPS job id" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac
safe_title=$(printf '%s' "$title" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_' | cut -c 1-80)
[ -n "$safe_title" ] || safe_title=job
final="$OUT_DIR/archive-$(printf '%06d' "$job_id")-$safe_title.raw"
tmp="$OUT_DIR/.archive-$job_id.$$.tmp"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
umask 027

if [ "$#" -eq 6 ]; then
    cat -- "$6" > "$tmp"
else
    cat > "$tmp"
fi

if ln "$tmp" "$final" 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    printf '%s\n' "INFO: archived CUPS job $job_id as $final" >&2
    exit 0
fi

if [ -f "$final" ] && cmp -s "$tmp" "$final"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    printf '%s\n' "INFO: CUPS retry for job $job_id already archived identically" >&2
    exit 0
fi

printf '%s\n' "ERROR: archive target collision for CUPS job $job_id" >&2
exit 1

ANTRIEB_ARCHIVE_BACKEND
